name: Moth
description: A pocket-sized dragon who sleeps in warm laundry and greets visitors with a curl of cinnamon-scented smoke.
magic: Keeps a room pleasantly warm; occasionally toasts unattended paperwork.
careNotes: Needs a heat-safe sleeping nook and supervised access to bookshelves.

name: Bramble
description: A silver-tabby familiar with enormous ears and a preference for people who read aloud.
magic: Finds lost objects by sleeping directly on top of them.
careNotes: Indoor home preferred. Requires a quiet windowsill and patient introductions to other cats.

name: Puddlewick
description: A moss-green toad who likes soft music, terracotta pots, and being addressed formally.
magic: Summons a brief indoor drizzle when deeply offended.
careNotes: Needs a humid habitat, fresh water, and a lid that closes securely.

name: Thistle
description: A dappled pony-sized unicorn who bonds slowly and then follows her person everywhere.
magic: Coaxes seedlings to sprout overnight when she is happy.
careNotes: Requires a fenced outdoor space, daily grooming, and companions who respect her boundaries.

name: Knuckle
description: A stout, stone-skinned companion who sits on the porch by day and patrols the garden by night.
magic: Detects approaching storms and hums softly before the first thunderclap.
careNotes: Needs a sturdy perch and regular mineral baths. Cannot live in an upstairs apartment.

name: Fennel
description: A russet fox kit whose tail glows like a candle whenever she discovers a new hiding place.
magic: Illuminates dark paths, though she sometimes turns the light off to start a game.
careNotes: Needs daily enrichment, secure fencing, and someone willing to retrieve stolen socks.

name: Vellum
description: A glossy raven who collects interesting words and insists on hearing how your day went.
magic: Can repeat a sentence in the voice of the person who first spoke it.
careNotes: Requires social time, puzzle feeders, and a home comfortable with unsolicited commentary.

name: Biscuit
description: A woolly little sheep who floats six inches above the floor and follows the smell of fresh bread.
magic: Her wool produces tiny harmless snowflakes when she dreams.
careNotes: Needs companionship, regular wool care, and ceiling fans kept off during naps.

name: Cinder
description: A charcoal-black salamander with ember-bright spots and a remarkable fondness for soup kitchens.
magic: Rekindles cold cooking fires with a sneeze.
careNotes: Needs a heat-safe enclosure. Currently on hold while recovering from a minor tail injury.

name: Marigold
description: A golden-eared hare who prefers a peaceful lap and the company of houseplants.
magic: Small acts of kindness near her sometimes come back as improbable good luck.
careNotes: Needs a calm home, soft bedding, and regular senior wellness checks.
